what: One line per push to dev, newest first: the repository's version (tools/version.json 'version'), the kit release it serves as newest, and what changed. site/build.py refuses a version without its line.

versions.what: api.storyboards.sgit.ai becomes the developer site: guides (write a storyboard, write a prop pack, render in a build, pin a release), the reference with a live gallery of every kind, setting, prop, pose and mood, the graph format, how the kit works inside, every patch against the upstream files as a diff, a page per release, tests, CI, the release process, and a documentation sidebar. And ABP-SB-001, code immutability: the behaviour policy in riskmandate.ai's shape, its compiled half in JSON, a Claude Code hook that denies any change to a published release folder and asks before any change to its own controls, a git pre-commit hook, and tests/test_policy.py. The kit is unchanged: release v0.1.0.
CI no longer asks a branch to bump the version when its commit is already on dev (a branch pushed alongside dev failed the check with nothing new in it). The kit is unchanged: release v0.1.0.

The first release. The kit gen-z-developers.sgit.ai and pki.sgit.ai each carried a copy of is served once, from /v0/v0.1/v0.1.0/, never to change: the drawing (four marked patches: prop packs, a per-site preferences key, the vocabulary and wire(), an embed's start view), pki.sgit.ai's props as the security pack, Rough.js and the two fonts vendored, and three new files: formats.js (validate, markdown, semantic graph), export.js (SVG, animated SVG, PNG, JPEG, contact sheet) and embed.js (<sg-storyboard>). Each file's SHA-256 and SRI string in the manifest; tools/release.py cuts and checks it; tests in Node and three browsers.
